livingCosts.notes: UBC first-year cost estimator defaults (Vancouver campus, standard on-campus residence), totalled over 8 months. Housing: residence $6,376-$8,996 for the year depending on room type, midpoint $7,686. Food: meal plan $7,712 for the year (964/month) + groceries $450/month. Transport 0: the U-Pass ($43.35/month) is included in student fees. Personal: books and supplies vary by programme ($800 Applied Science to $2,500 Computer Science for this file's programmes), midpoint $1,650/year; the estimator has no default for clothing, phone or social spending, so these are not included.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts
programmes.notes: C$1,717.68/credit x 30 credits (2026/27). Compulsory = UBC Athletics & Recreation fee, AMS fees (excl. opt-out health & dental plan) and U-Pass x 2 terms, plus Arts undergraduate society fees, per the 2026/27 Calendar; iMED insurance excluded. New international students: increases capped at 3%/yr for 4 years. 2024/2025 = that year's new-student per-credit rate x 30 (UBC Calendar archive).
